narrative.summary: We now have an operational Pharos-based workbench linking scoped questions to evidence graphs, cited answers and auditable exports. Completed comparisons informed a task-specific ranking feature. The next scientific objective is to demonstrate a predictive benefit from Steward's evidence qualification.
accomplishments: Built a guided Pharos/CIViC workbench with cited answers, evidence graphs and exports preserving the original graph and every edge decision. Clean installation and real-data replay are verified.

Integrated IntAct/IMEx with the official JAMI reader and PSI-MI standards. Added exact UniProt mappings in SSSOM format and record-level reuse checks; development replay preserves curated assay context through answers and exports.

Fixed PyKEEN R-GCN tests found no consistent GO/Reactome gain. On 2,676 assay-tested pairs, native STRING physical versus functional scores ranked detections with average precision 0.190 versus 0.173 and numeric coverage 72.4% versus 88.3%; an older-source control agreed.

Implemented optional STRING physical-association priority with saved source responses. The BRAF demonstration retains all 21 matching proteins, including seven without physical scores, and preserves evidence paths and review states.
Connected NVIDIA Nemotron through vLLM on Brev with scope checks and plan review. Deterministic construction works; autonomous task selection remains experimental. AWS credits are available.
blockers: The main scientific gap is a demonstrated benefit from Steward's qualification beyond the same source information. Existing ranking comparisons use development data; upstream source reuse limits independent interpretation.

Checked Pharos interaction records lack detailed assay provenance, so we keep missing context and verified reuse explicit. The fresh IntAct assessment needs a tested runner before opening the selected studies. Independent user assessment also remains pending.
Please confirm the baseline graph version, expected export formats and treatment of undecided edges in the subgraph comparison. Brev access and AWS credits are available.
milestones: Freeze and complete the fresh source-preservation assessment. Publish one repeatable biological case study with a clear claim-to-source trace.
Verify a source-supported change to the learner's actual graph inputs. Run a matched comparison only if that change is established; complete an independent user walkthrough.
Finalize the Pharos subgraph, complete edge-decision ledger, licensed code, evaluation results and reproducible demonstration in the organizers' required format.
